R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.
R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.risk_if_missing: Wrong verifier binding or cross-contract replay risk.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R2_VERIFYING_CONTRACT_PRESENT.description: EIP712Domain typehash should include address verifyingContract.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.
R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.risk_if_missing: Wrong verifier binding or cross-contract replay risk.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.
R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.risk_if_missing: Wrong verifier binding or cross-contract replay risk.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

critical_issues: R5/R9: Stale cached DOMAIN_SEPARATOR: assigned in constructor/initializer and used directly in permit() without chainId recomputation.
R6: Upgradeable/proxy context with cached DOMAIN_SEPARATOR and no visible recomputation.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.
R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.risk_if_missing: Wrong verifier binding or cross-contract replay risk.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.
R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.risk_if_missing: Wrong verifier binding or cross-contract replay risk.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.
R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.risk_if_missing: Wrong verifier binding or cross-contract replay risk.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R2_VERIFYING_CONTRACT_PRESENT.description: EIP712Domain typehash should include address verifyingContract.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.
R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.risk_if_missing: Wrong verifier binding or cross-contract replay risk.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R2_VERIFYING_CONTRACT_PRESENT.description: EIP712Domain typehash should include address verifyingContract.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.
R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.risk_if_missing: Wrong verifier binding or cross-contract replay risk.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.

R3_DYNAMIC_CHAIN_ID.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should use block.chainid or chainid(), not a stale/hardcoded chain ID.

R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR should bind to address(this) unless a deliberate external verifier is used.
R4_CORRECT_VERIFYING_CONTRACT.risk_if_missing: Wrong verifier binding or cross-contract replay risk.

R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.description: If DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is cached in constructor/initializer, it should be recomputed or invalidated when block.chainid changes.
R5_NO_STALE_CACHED_DOMAIN.risk_if_missing: Stale domain separator after chain split/fork.

R6_PROXY_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: Upgradeable/proxy contracts should avoid stale cached domains and bind signatures to the proxy/verifier actually used.

R7_LOGICAL_DOMAIN_DISAMBIGUATION.description: If one verifier handles multiple logical domains, domain or signed struct should include salt/poolId/marketId/vaultId/accountId or equivalent.

R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.description: If salt is used, it should be meaningful and unique per logical signing domain; zero/constant salt should be justified.
R8_SALT_CORRECTNESS.risk_if_missing: False sense of domain uniqueness or duplicated logical domains.

R9_PERMIT_USES_SAFE_DOMAIN.description: permit() should use a current/recomputed domain separator or a safe cached separator with chainId invalidation.
